ideal.about: Theoretical ceiling: no stops, no scrap, takt exactly 90 s.

healthy_realistic.about: Normal day: micro-stops and base scrap, no faults.

hero_timely_repair.about: M05 bearing wear caught by the anomaly detector, technician sent 5 min after the alert. The demo path.

hero_delayed_repair.about: Same fault, repair starts 40 min late.

hero_ignored.about: Same fault, ignored: M05 seizes and the line waits for the emergency repair.
